Borrowings.label: Borrowings
Borrowings.documentation: The amount of outstanding funds that the entity is obligated to repay.

ShorttermBorrowings.label: Current borrowings
ShorttermBorrowings.documentation: The amount of current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

CurrentBorrowingsAndCurrentPortionOfNonc.label: Current borrowings and current portion of non-current borrowings
CurrentBorrowingsAndCurrentPortionOfNonc.documentation: The amount of current borrowings and current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

CurrentPortionOfLongtermBorrowings.label: Current portion of non-current borrowings
CurrentPortionOfLongtermBorrowings.documentation: The current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

LongtermBorrowings.label: Non-current portion of non-current borrowings
LongtermBorrowings.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

OtherBorrowings.label: Other borrowings
OtherBorrowings.documentation: The amount of borrowings that the entity does not separately disclose in the same statement or note. [Refer: Borrowings]

OtherCurrentBorrowingsAndCurrentPortionO.label: Other current borrowings and current portion of other non-current borrowings
OtherCurrentBorrowingsAndCurrentPortionO.documentation: The amount of current other borrowings and the current portion of non-current other borrowings. [Refer: Other borrowings]

NoncurrentPortionOfOtherNoncurrentBorrow.label: Non-current portion of other non-current borrowings
NoncurrentPortionOfOtherNoncurrentBorrow.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current other borrowings. [Refer: Other borrowings]

CurrentLoansReceivedAndCurrentPortionOfN.label: Current loans received and current portion of non-current loans received
CurrentLoansReceivedAndCurrentPortionOfN.documentation: The amount of current loans received and the current portion of non-current loans received. [Refer: Loans received]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentLoansReceiv.label: Non-current portion of non-current loans received
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentLoansReceiv.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current loans received. [Refer: Loans received]

SecuredBankLoansReceived.label: Secured bank loans received
SecuredBankLoansReceived.documentation: The amount of loans received from banks that have been secured by collateral. [Refer: Loans received]

CurrentSecuredBankLoansReceivedAndCurren.label: Current secured bank loans received and current portion of non-current secured bank loans received
CurrentSecuredBankLoansReceivedAndCurren.documentation: The amount of current secured bank loans received and the current portion of non-current secured bank loans received. [Refer: Secured bank loans received]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentSecuredBank.label: Non-current portion of non-current secured bank loans received
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentSecuredBank.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current secured bank loans received. [Refer: Secured bank loans received]

UnsecuredBankLoansReceived.label: Unsecured bank loans received
UnsecuredBankLoansReceived.documentation: The amount of loans received from banks that have not been secured by collateral. [Refer: Loans received]

CurrentUnsecuredBankLoansReceivedAndCurr.label: Current unsecured bank loans received and current portion of non-current unsecured bank loans received
CurrentUnsecuredBankLoansReceivedAndCurr.documentation: The amount of current unsecured bank loans received and the current portion of non-current unsecured bank loans received. [Refer: Unsecured bank loans received]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentUnsecuredBa.label: Non-current portion of non-current unsecured bank loans received
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentUnsecuredBa.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current unsecured bank loans received. [Refer: Unsecured bank loans received]

BondsIssued.label: Bonds issued
BondsIssued.documentation: The amount of bonds issued by the entity.

CurrentBondsIssuedAndCurrentPortionOfNon.label: Current bonds issued and current portion of non-current bonds issued
CurrentBondsIssuedAndCurrentPortionOfNon.documentation: The amount of current bonds issued and the current portion of non-current bonds issued. [Refer: Bonds issued]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentBondsIssued.label: Non-current portion of non-current bonds issued
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentBondsIssued.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current bonds issued. [Refer: Bonds issued]

NotesAndDebenturesIssued.label: Notes and debentures issued
NotesAndDebenturesIssued.documentation: The amount of notes and debentures issued by the entity.

CurrentNotesAndDebenturesIssuedAndCurren.label: Current notes and debentures issued and current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued
CurrentNotesAndDebenturesIssuedAndCurren.documentation: The amount of current notes and debentures issued and the current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued. [Refer: Notes and debentures issued]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentNotesAndDeb.label: Non-current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentNotesAndDeb.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current notes and debentures issued. [Refer: Notes and debentures issued]

CommercialPapersIssued.label: Commercial papers issued
CommercialPapersIssued.documentation: The amount of commercial paper issued by the entity.

CurrentCommercialPapersIssuedAndCurrentP.label: Current commercial papers issued and current portion of non-current commercial papers issued
CurrentCommercialPapersIssuedAndCurrentP.documentation: The amount of current commercial paper issued and the current portion of non-current commercial paper issued. [Refer: Commercial papers issued]

NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentCommercialP.label: Non-current portion of non-current commercial papers issued
NoncurrentPortionOfNoncurrentCommercialP.documentation: The non-current portion of non-current commercial paper issued. [Refer: Commercial papers issued]

DebtSecurities.label: Debt instruments issued
DebtSecurities.documentation: The amount of instruments issued by the entity that represent indebtedness.

CurrentDebtInstrumentsIssued.label: Current debt instruments issued
CurrentDebtInstrumentsIssued.documentation: The amount of current debt instruments issued. [Refer: Debt instruments issued]

NoncurrentDebtInstrumentsIssued.label: Non-current debt instruments issued
NoncurrentDebtInstrumentsIssued.documentation: The amount of non-current debt instruments issued. [Refer: Debt instruments issued]

BankOverdraftsClassifiedAsCashEquivalent.label: Bank overdrafts
BankOverdraftsClassifiedAsCashEquivalent.documentation: The amount that has been withdrawn from an account in excess of existing cash balances. This is considered a short-term extension of credit by the bank. [Refer: Cash and cash equivalents]

LeaseLiabilities.label: Lease liabilities
LeaseLiabilities.documentation: The amount of liabilities related to the entity's leases. Lease is a contract, or part of a contract, that conveys the right to use an underlying asset for a period of time in exchange for consideration.

CurrentLeaseLiabilities.label: Current lease liabilities
CurrentLeaseLiabilities.documentation: The amount of current lease liabilities. [Refer: Lease liabilities]

NoncurrentLeaseLiabilities.label: Non-current lease liabilities
NoncurrentLeaseLiabilities.documentation: The amount of non-current lease liabilities. [Refer: Lease liabilities]

NetDebt.label: Net debt
NetDebt.documentation: The amount of net debt of the entity.

DebtInstrumentsIssuedAtAmortisedCost.label: Debt instruments issued at amortised cost
DebtInstrumentsIssuedAtAmortisedCost.documentation: The amount of instruments issued by the entity that represent indebtedness at amortised cost. [Refer: Financial liabilities at amortised cost]

DebtInstrumentsIssuedAtFairValueThroughP.label: Debt instruments issued at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently
DebtInstrumentsIssuedAtFairValueThroughP.documentation: The amount of instruments issued by the entity that represent indebtedness at fair value through profit or loss that were designated as such upon initial recognition or subsequently. [Refer: Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss, designated upon initial recognition or subsequently]

BondsIssuedUndiscountedCashFlows.label: Bonds issued, undiscounted cash flows
BondsIssuedUndiscountedCashFlows.documentation: The amount of contractual undiscounted cash flows in relation to bonds issued. [Refer: Bonds issued]

BankBorrowingsUndiscountedCashFlows.label: Bank borrowings, undiscounted cash flows
BankBorrowingsUndiscountedCashFlows.documentation: The amount of contractual undiscounted cash flows in relation to bank borrowings. [Refer: Borrowings]

BorrowingsRecognisedAsOfAcquisitionDate.label: Borrowings recognised as of acquisition date
BorrowingsRecognisedAsOfAcquisitionDate.documentation: The amount recognised as of the acquisition date for borrowings assumed in a business combination. [Refer: Borrowings; Total for all business combinations [member]]

UndrawnBorrowingFacilities.label: Undrawn borrowing facilities
UndrawnBorrowingFacilities.documentation: The amount of undrawn borrowing facilities that may be available for future operating activities and to settle capital commitments. [Refer: Capital commitments]

GrossLoanCommitments.label: Gross loan commitments
GrossLoanCommitments.documentation: The amount of contractual undiscounted cash flows for gross commitments to receive a loan.

LoansPayableInDefault.label: Loans payable in default
LoansPayableInDefault.documentation: The amount of loans payable in default.

LoansPayableInBreachWhichPermittedLender.label: Loans payable in breach which permitted lender to demand accelerated repayment
LoansPayableInBreachWhichPermittedLender.documentation: The amount of loans payable in breach of the terms that permitted the lender to demand accelerated repayment.
